species.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scav­ enges for edibles the entire day.
It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.
Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush­ rooms on its back.
Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

abilities.short_effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: water-absorb
abilities.effect: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.
abilities.short_effect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: oblivious
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

abilities.name: cloud-nine
abilities.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.
abilities.short_effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

abilities.name: compound-eyes
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.
abilities.short_effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.

abilities.name: insomnia
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents sleep.

abilities.name: immunity
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents poison.

abilities.name: flash-fire
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

abilities.name: shield-dust
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

abilities.name: own-tempo
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents confusion.

abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
abilities.short_effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: levitate
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.
abilities.short_effect: Evades Ground moves.

abilities.name: effect-spore
abilities.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: synchronize
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.
abilities.short_effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

abilities.name: clear-body
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: natural-cure
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.
abilities.short_effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: lightning-rod
abilities.effect: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.
abilities.short_effect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

abilities.name: serene-grace
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

abilities.name: swift-swim
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles Speed during rain.

abilities.name: chlorophyll
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: illuminate
abilities.effect: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles the wild encounter rate.

abilities.name: trace
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.
abilities.short_effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

abilities.name: poison-point
abilities.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: inner-focus
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot flinch.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents flinching.

abilities.name: water-veil
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents burns.

abilities.name: magnet-pull
abilities.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: soundproof
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against sound-based moves.

abilities.name: rain-dish
abilities.effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.
abilities.short_effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: pressure
abilities.effect: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
abilities.short_effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

abilities.name: thick-fat
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
abilities.short_effect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

abilities.name: early-bird
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.
abilities.short_effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

abilities.name: flame-body
abilities.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
abilities.short_effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: keen-eye
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: hyper-cutter
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: pickup
abilities.effect: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
abilities.short_effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

abilities.name: hustle
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

abilities.name: cute-charm
abilities.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: sticky-hold
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: shed-skin
abilities.effect: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: guts
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
abilities.short_effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: marvel-scale
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
abilities.short_effect: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: liquid-ooze
abilities.effect: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.
abilities.short_effect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: overgrow
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: blaze
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: torrent
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: swarm
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: rock-head
abilities.effect: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against recoil damage.

abilities.name: drought
abilities.effect: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
abilities.short_effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

abilities.name: arena-trap
abilities.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

abilities.name: vital-spirit
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents sleep.

abilities.name: shell-armor
abilities.effect: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against critical hits.

abilities.name: tangled-feet
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles evasion when confused.

abilities.name: rivalry
abilities.effect: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.
abilities.short_effect: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

abilities.name: steadfast
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

abilities.name: snow-cloak
abilities.effect: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.
abilities.short_effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

abilities.name: gluttony
abilities.effect: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.
abilities.short_effect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

abilities.name: anger-point
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: unburden
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

abilities.name: dry-skin
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.
abilities.short_effect: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: download
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage. In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.
abilities.short_effect: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: iron-fist
abilities.effect: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: adaptability
abilities.effect: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.
abilities.short_effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

abilities.name: skill-link
abilities.effect: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.
abilities.short_effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
abilities.short_effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: solar-power
abilities.effect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
abilities.short_effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: quick-feet
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
abilities.short_effect: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: sniper
abilities.effect: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

abilities.name: magic-guard
abilities.effect: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

abilities.name: no-guard
abilities.effect: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
abilities.short_effect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

abilities.name: technician
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: leaf-guard
abilities.effect: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: mold-breaker
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.
abilities.short_effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

abilities.name: aftermath
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
abilities.short_effect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

abilities.name: anticipation
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.
abilities.short_effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

abilities.name: forewarn
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold 120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat 80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out 0 | Any such move not listed
abilities.short_effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

abilities.name: unaware
abilities.effect: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.
abilities.short_effect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

abilities.name: tinted-lens
abilities.effect: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

abilities.name: filter
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.
abilities.short_effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

abilities.name: scrappy
abilities.effect: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
abilities.short_effect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

abilities.name: ice-body
abilities.effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.
abilities.short_effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

abilities.name: frisk
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.
abilities.short_effect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

abilities.name: reckless
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: sheer-force
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate. Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

abilities.name: unnerve
abilities.effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.
abilities.short_effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

abilities.name: defiant
abilities.effect: When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages. If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: cursed-body
abilities.effect: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

abilities.name: healer
abilities.effect: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: friend-guard
abilities.effect: All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle. This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.
abilities.short_effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

abilities.name: weak-armor
abilities.effect: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

abilities.name: multiscale
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage when it is hit having full HP.
abilities.short_effect: Halves damage taken from full HP.

abilities.name: harvest
abilities.effect: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

abilities.name: overcoat
abilities.effect: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against damage from weather.

abilities.name: poison-touch
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit. This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust. This ability takes effect before Mummy.
abilities.short_effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

abilities.name: regenerator
abilities.effect: This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted. This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.
abilities.short_effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

abilities.name: big-pecks
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through Heart Swap or Guard Swap.
abilities.short_effect: Protects against Defense drops.

abilities.name: sand-rush
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
abilities.short_effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: wonder-skin
abilities.effect: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.
abilities.short_effect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

abilities.name: analytic
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn. Future Sight and Doom Desire are unaffected.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

abilities.name: imposter
abilities.effect: This Pokémon transforms into a random opponent upon entering battle. This effect is identical to the move Transform.
abilities.short_effect: Transforms upon entering battle.

abilities.name: infiltrator
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves ignore Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
abilities.short_effect: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

abilities.name: moxie
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon. This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes. If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

abilities.name: justified
abilities.effect: Whenever a Dark-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage. The move is not negated in any way.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

abilities.name: rattled
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage with each hit from a damaging Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

abilities.name: sand-force
abilities.effect: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power. This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
abilities.short_effect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.short_effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: neutralizing-gas
abilities.effect: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
abilities.short_effect: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.
